decisive_items: Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma
A subcutaneous nodule of approximately 1 cm diameter was present under the hypogastrium.

response.rationale: The histology showing endometrial glands and stroma in a subcutaneous scar-associated hypogastric nodule with catamenial pain is diagnostic. R1 best combines the abdominal wall location and the localized mass/endometrioma character.

rejected.why: Identifies a mass but lacks the abdominal wall localization and scar-associated context, making it less specific.
Correct category but too broad; abdominal endometriosis could imply intraperitoneal disease, whereas the lesion is clearly subcutaneous and scar-associated.
